basics.name: MohammadReza Vazifeh
basics.label: Full-Stack .NET Developer & Software Architect
basics.summary: Full-Stack .NET Developer & Software Architect. The .NET path starts with OOP and C# in 2013; commercial production starts in 2018. Work sits on three tracks: modern .NET architecture (.NET 9/10, Clean Architecture, DDD, CQRS, Microservices), applied AI and computer vision (ALPR on Python and FastAPI), and process automation plus realtime systems (n8n, RabbitMQ, Redis, SignalR, MQL5). Recent work includes official full-time On-site/Hybrid employment on a municipal school-transport platform with more than 200,000 users in some cities, and a part-time remote contracting engagement on a .NET MAUI gold ERP for the Kuwait market at Ayar Plus (عیار پلاس), outside Pazhoohan working hours.

work.name: Ayar Plus
work.summary: * Part-time remote technical contractor. Work sat outside hours of the primary official full-time On-site/Hybrid role at Ertebatat Pazhoohan Matin; no conflict of interest, commercial competition, or contractual bar with that contract. Custom accounting software for the Kuwait market; employer Iranian, based in Kuwait. .NET MAUI frontend: XAML, multilingual UI, gold ERP (inventory, gold math, gold accounting) on .NET 10 integrated with a PHP backend. * Online and offline invoicing; Windows client discovered the Android client on the LAN and queued requests until the app was online. * App on Google Play; CI/CD published Android and iOS to Google Play and the App Store so customers were not disrupted. * Card readers in Kuwait gold shops for Civil ID scans; card photos stored on ImageKit and used in the Android app. * For a stretch also project coordination: remote weekly sprints, daily and weekly meetings; MAUI colleague in Mashhad, backend in Qom, bridge to the Product Owner. * Started a full cross-platform rewrite on Bit Platform with migration of old data; packages for PDF and printing receipts and invoices.

work.name: Ertebatat Pazhoohan Matin
work.summary: * Primary official full-time On-site/Hybrid employment after BahamShop. Enterprise school-transport platform for municipalities (Shiraz, Isfahan, Qazvin) on C# and Onion Architecture. Features, reports, query work, speed. * Some cities had more than 200,000 users; accounting and the payment gateway sat on the same platform among fleets, services, drivers, students, and parents, including an inspector role. * At the start designed Safir Mehr, a native Kotlin Android fleet app for customers. * ALPR for inspectors with Python and FastAPI: photo in, plate text out, check against the company fleet. * Much of the work in Cursor: rules and skills on the models, code review, fast MVPs. One MVP was a Snapp-like trip app on .NET 10, PostgreSQL Polygon, SignalR, and Redis (request, driver accept/reject, dashboard, fleet in admin). * Contract term ended Jul 2026. Overlapping part-time remote contractor role at Ayar Plus from Sep 2025 through Sep 2026, outside Pazhoohan working hours.

work.name: BahamShop (Product Search Engine Startup)
work.summary: * Product search engine with a scraper and click revenue. Site had no revenue until I joined; it reached income in the first month. * Role: Technical Lead and Backend Automation Architect. * Architected the search backend on ASP.NET Core 9 with Clean Architecture and caching. * Engineered n8n pipelines that prepared copy per product tag and category; the SEO team edited and inserted it, which raised product indexing speed. * Figma was a side tool for UI drafts. * Tenure closed Jun 2025; moved to the next role.

work.position: Independent engineer; trading systems, automation, and architecture R&D
work.name: Independent
work.summary: * Shifted focus to trading systems, automation, and architecture research. Wrote MQL4 and MQL5 trading bots with module backtesting, budget management, trading mindset, and capital management. * Practiced Blazor Hybrid and the .NET MAUI path for cross-platform clients. * Built a few .NET samples that implemented a smart contract inside a .NET project. * Deepened Git, Agile/Scrum, and DevOps; learned Docker. * Raised architecture fluency including Onion Architecture and older styles. * Used Python on trading systems; practiced Pine Script. * Part-time consulting through Dec 2024: e-commerce sites and n8n automation pipelines.

work.position: Electricity-distribution automation support and development; microservices rewrite
work.name: ParsiaAfzar FaraAndishanNovin
work.summary: * Supported and developed an existing MVC electricity-distribution automation system (Bushehr, Mazandaran, Greater Tehran, Arak, and other cities) via tickets, development, and bug fixes. * Proposed and implemented a unified rewrite with Microservices, CQRS, RabbitMQ, DDD, Vue.js, monitoring, and .NET Core. * Built a custom ASP.NET Core MVC CMS for the company site. * In Jan 2023 shifted focus to trading systems and independent research.

work.position: .NET Developer; project follow-up in late tenure
work.name: Rasta Tejarat Beinolmelal Rastak
work.summary: * First real use of Git and DevOps; with the then project manager, moved the company from informal process onto Agile/Scrum and DevOps. * Worked on the CRM (including Angular) and networked investment platforms; also a Resource Scheduling & Reservation System. * Late in the tenure, took over project follow-up after the then project manager left.

work.name: Nikan Exir Vista Rayan
work.summary: * Backend .NET developer: designed and implemented ASP.NET Core REST APIs for a queue-management system and worked with the team's new PWA. * Learned SQL Server on the job against real data. * First production .NET role after two years of military service; company focus was accounting software.
